domain_description: A Spotify playlist generator that turns a user's target duration and mood or vibe into a real Spotify playlist preview and, when requested, creates that playlist in the user's Spotify account.

use_cases.description: Generate a playlist from a mood or vibe and target duration, returning selected tracks with album cover, track name, duration, and singer or artist names.
Create a Spotify playlist for the current user from the generated track list.
Help the user set up OAuth for Spotify playlist write access without storing secrets in generated files.

glossary.definition: A user-owned Spotify collection of tracks.
A natural language vibe such as rainy indie, workout, chill focus, party, romantic, or late-night drive.
A Spotify song item with name, artists, album artwork, URI, Spotify URL, and duration.
The requested total listening time for the generated playlist.
An ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code used by Spotify to filter track availability.
